//: The FIFTH typecheck program: the repo's own tooling under scripts/.
It exists for the same reason tsconfig.workbench.json does. A .ts file that
no program covers is a file nobody checks, and this repo has already paid
for one of those — the Button story rendered a prop that did not exist for
several releases because stories sat outside every program. A gate script
that silently stops gating is the same failure with a longer fuse.
It cannot ride along in the workbench program: that one sets `types: []`
and pulls in the DOM lib for the stories, while a script needs @types/node
and nothing else. The base config already provides exactly that, so this
Scripts run under plain `node` with native type-stripping, like the token
generator, so `erasableSyntaxOnly` from the base is load-bearing here: it
rejects the constructs Node cannot execute (enum, namespace, parameter
properties) at typecheck time rather than at 3am in CI.
